title: Enhancing Large Image Acquisition, Sharing, and Understanding With Web-Based Workflows
content: Large volumetric and high dimensional image data presents significant computational challenges. We address these challenges with a modular, cloud-native framework built for rapid application development. We developed the Acquire Zarr streaming library for efficient data acquisition and storage in OME-Zarr format, enabling handling of massive datasets. In addition, we emphasize modularity in data access, processing, and visualization. This motivates us to create web-based interactive visualization solutions and a flexible human-in-the-loop (HITL) analysis platform that can be quickly adapted for diverse annotation tasks, minimizing engineering overhead and accelerating the development of tailored bioimaging applications. We will showcase examples ranging from cryoET tomograms to volumetric time-lapse lightsheet images.
